description: Cases for a visit's topic (assets/scripts/visit-topic.sh). Every case is the visit named by visit, on the subject named by subject, carrying the case's metadata. kind is what visit_topic_kind decides, fold_topic is what visit_fold_topic gives for the subject, and demand_topic is what visit_demand_topic gives, empty for no topic. visit-topic.test.sh runs the defs over these cases. converse-fold-scope.test.sh, converse-hold.test.sh and converse-signoff.test.sh run their consumers over them, and their stubs serve the visit under this id and the subject under this id.
